alt: Global maps of start and end of season for summer and winter crops
title: Enhancing WorldCereal crop calendars with land surface phenology and machine learning
result: Global start- and end-of-season calendars for 11 crops from MODIS phenology, ERA5-Land climate and XGBoost, with explicit winter-cereal dormancy. R² 0.90–0.94 against reference calendars.

alt: Winter wheat NDVI time series with phenological stages and growing degree days
title: Tracking winter wheat development in thermal time
result: PlanetScope NDVI and growing degree days resolve sowing, tillering, grain filling and senescence, and the effect of fertilisation and irrigation, in a Mediterranean wheat trial.

alt: Map of Spain with Köppen-Geiger climate classes and wheat and barley calibration and validation parcels
title: The yield strikes back: Enhancing the transferability of field scale wheat and barley yield models by leveraging Sentinel-1/2
result: Field-scale wheat and barley yield models normalised in thermal time (growing degree days) and driven by optical and radar indices, tested across Spanish regions and seasons. SWIR (B11) indices gave the best and most stable performance.

alt: Directional differences of Sen2Like bands over Belgium after BRDF corrections
title: Sen2Like: Paving the Way towards Harmonization and Fusion of Optical Data
result: Copernicus software that harmonises and fuses Landsat 8/9 with Sentinel-2 into analysis-ready data through co-registration, atmospheric and BRDF corrections, including the HABA BRDF normalisation developed at the University of Valencia.
citation: Saunier, Pflug, Moletto-Lobos, Franch et al. (2022) · Remote Sensing 14(16), 3855
